The issuer shows solid operating profitability with EBIT of 3,639M on 12,222M revenue (high margin), and has positive retained earnings, which supports earnings capacity. However, leverage is high (total liabilities of 78,289M against equity of 18,552M, with a current ratio of only 1.27), which increases refinancing and balance-sheet risk. Overall, the credit profile appears adequate but not investment-grade strong on leverage and liquidity.  
DECISION: BBB-
